messages.subject: Order# L-42686
messages.text:
Good evening team,

I ordered a pair of gloves 3 weeks ago for my mom, but unfortunately the size she requested is too big for her. The gloves have not been used. Is it possible to exchange them for a pair of medium? I ordered the large ones (as she requested). Let me know how we can proceed. 

Thanks,

Phil

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Re: Order# L-42686
messages.text:
Hello Philippe,
 

 First of all, I would like to apologize for the delay in response. We are facing workforce challenges, but the delay remains unacceptable and contrary to our usual practices.
 

 Here are the instructions for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Visit https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products you wish to return and then choose the replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and attach the label to the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags instead of boxes, as they are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once we receive the return, we will send the new product(s) and will ask to pay a $9.99 exchange fee (if applicable) 😊
 

 Warm regards,
 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
